name: Chives
description: A clump-forming perennial in the allium family producing hollow tubular leaves and globe-shaped violet blossoms in late spring.
use: Bread and butter, eggs, potatoes. Adds a delicate, onion-like freshness when snipped fresh over dishes.
tips: Cut leaves near the base to stimulate ongoing production. Thrives in fertile, moist soil under full sun to light shade.
